text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Trainer, over here!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming all this way! I 
really wanted you to see this event, no 
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The performers, the staff, and me... 
we'll give it everything we've got to put 
on a show!

Just as promised, the live event radiated 
an astounding level of energy.

Unceasing cheers and thunderous applause. 
Amidst a sea of smiling faces, it 
concluded with tremendous success.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: How was today's stage, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Everyone up on stage and 
in the audience was all smiles.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
At the live event that marks my very 
origins, I wanted... more than anything to 
show it to you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even as unreliable as I used to be, I've 
grown enough to do this much now!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Not good enough at all!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My calculations were way, way too 
optimistic! Jeez~~...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The audio lag completely ruined our 
banter! And the music sped up way faster 
than in rehearsal, which dragged out the 
MC segment and burdened the performers...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If only we had held more meetings 
beforehand... If only I had double-checked 
everything during rehearsals.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I've only just reached the starting line. 
I'm still so far from my ideal...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No! That's not true at all! Because what 
I'm aiming for is—
(*Grummmble……*)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hau!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Mmm-mmm... So good~...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't believe I skipped lunch. It 
slipped my mind completely.
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! If I collapse, everything will 
have been for no――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, sorry. I just remembered something 
like this happening before.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Remember the day we went out for the first 
time? Your stomach was rumbling just like 
this back then, too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Since that time... work has gotten even 
further on track. And you've achieved even 
greater success, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I went and made the exact same 
mistake again... Uuugh.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I still tend to push myself too hard 
sometimes. Even when trying to relax, I 
often catch myself working instead.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Every time that happens, it hits me. I 
really still have so much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still... I learned one very important 
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Show the Trainer the importance of relying 
on others!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll keep relying on Trainer and 
causing trouble down the line.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes... can I borrow 
Trainer-san's time like this again?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll grow stronger. Strong 
enough to support you one day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer!
